infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Tidyups shares your live position with dispatch only while you tap 'Start Sharing Location' as a cleaner heading to a job. Sharing stops the moment you tap Stop.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Tidyups uses the camera so cleaners can snap before-and-after photos of the job site to share results with the customer.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Tidyups accesses your photo library so you can attach an existing before/after photo to a job or upload a business logo/promo image.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Tidyups saves job photos back to your library only if you tap Save.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Tidyups uses your location to share your live position with dispatch while you head to a job site.
